Petition of Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company d/b/a National Grid pursuant to the Company’s Tariffs M.D.P.U. Nos. 1201, § 8B and 1202, § 8B for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's (1) Standard Complete Billing Percentages for effect May 1, 2017 and (2) reconciliation of competitive supplier balances for the period May 1, 2016 through April 30, 2017, under the Company’s Purchase of Receivables Program.
